finding: Numbers parsed from a provider error body become a persistent input bound for the (provider, model) until an operator runs the paid probe; a single malformed or hostile message of the shape 'prompt is too long: 1 tokens > 1 maximum' (or a 413 byte-size refusal on a text-light payload) sets the bound near zero and every later request preempts with CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.

remediation: Before lowering: require FLOOR_MAX_TOKENS <= limit <= context_window, observed >= cheval's own estimate, and input_tokens > limit for the parsed shape; record with observed_input_tokens null (no bound effect) when the message states nothing; consider an expiry on observed rows.
